algorithm: Importance-corrected external-sampling MCCFR, tabular regret matching, alternating player updates, full-support opponent proposal .9*sigma+.1*uniform; unweighted iterations and unbiased own-reach/sample-reach average strategy
scope: Kuhn correctness and a separate Ra-inspired miniature. Fully public additive tile scores, 5 tiles, 2 disks/player, +2/-2 terminal disk-sum extrema, one epoch, maximum TWO auctions. No official Ra engine, collection scoring, hidden points, god/disasters choices or production MCTS comparison. No neural models. Multiplayer zero-total centered utilities do NOT imply Nash convergence.
primary: Two-player exact NashConv=sum_i(BR_i-profileValue_i); multiplayer paired change in own centered-score utility against each baseline, comparing trained seat versus same-seat all-baseline control. Rank-score change auxiliary. Fixed player-count-specific starting disks; all candidate seats evaluated. Three training seeds descriptive, not confirmatory.
